snippet.title: Witchkeeping | Demo Gameplay | October 2026 Next Fest
snippet.description:
Witchkeeping is a cozy narrative organizing game about a witch urgently appointed to an academy library. Fly your broom, shelve the books by solving their puzzles, and put the wands away. Open the owl’s letters, sort out the valley’s odd troubles, and find out what happened to Madame Vesper.

📺 Watch the Full Series
Looking for the next episode or starting from the beginning? Find all the cozy adventures in this series here:
👉 Playlist: October 2026 Next Fest [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOgoPqz7H8p0]

👉Game Link [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5169710/Witchkeeping/]

✦ ───────────── ✦
🎮 Join the Gaming Adventure
Relax, unwind, and enjoy cozy gameplay, one pixel at a time. Blind Playthroughs and Narrative Storytelling.
